audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer read Skill for levels 1 through 6 while the content layer and the packet both read Malzahar for all five rows.
audit.why: Void Shift gives him damage reduction and crowd-control immunity whenever he has not recently been hit, Call of the Void is 900 range on a flat 6 seconds with a silence, and Malefic Visions ticks on after the trade ends. Azir's Q is 740 on 14 seconds at rank 1 for 70 mana. He wins every prolonged exchange in that window.
audit.corrected: phases[0..4].side moved to Malzahar with all five whys rewritten in the same proposal; win[0..4] already read Malzahar, so the layers now agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page put no number on his level 6 spike and described Nether Grasp as a 'root-and-burst combo'.
audit.why: Nether Grasp is a suppression on 140/110/80 seconds at 700 range. Calling it a root understates it — suppression ignores tenacity and only removal answers it — and a 140-second cooldown at rank 1 is an enormous punish window that the page never told the reader about.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, phases[4].why and breakdown.cooldowns now carry the real numbers and call it suppression.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three decisive interactions were absent and breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT). The page also called Void Shift a 'passive shield'.
audit.why: First, Nether Grasp is a channel — Riot's own flag and text agree that CC interrupts it, and Emperor's Divide knocks back, so the wall ends the suppression. Second, Call of the Void silences: if you pre-cast Shifting Sands you are stuck with no dash for its duration, which is the interaction flagged in missingInteractions. Third, Void Shift is damage reduction plus CC immunity that lingers only while he has not been hit, so one soldier auto strips it — it is not a shield with a health value.
audit.corrected: Written into dosFull[0].d (channel break), dosFull[1].d (strip Void Shift first), dontsFull[2].d (silence plus fog), breakdown.cooldowns and the early paragraph.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim under a spacing title, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim under a flank-warding title, and wants.foe[1] read 'Land Malefic Visions/Void Swarm and follow with root/burst' — the packet flagged the name and the effect is a suppression, not a root.
audit.why: Both bled bullets promise one thing and explain another; the wants line misnames the effect of his ultimate.
audit.corrected: Both bullets rewritten to answer their titles; wants.foe[1] now says suppress.

notes: Full-layer chart was stale on rows 1-6 and has been moved onto the content chart and the packet, which agreed; every moved side has its why rewritten in the same proposal, and win[] needed no edit. The most valuable thing missing from this page was that Nether Grasp is a channel and Emperor's Divide's knockback interrupts it — that reframes the entire level 6 window and is now stated in three places. Also corrected the repeated description of Void Shift as a 'passive shield': Riot's text gives damage reduction and CC immunity conditional on not having been hit, with no health value, so 'strip it with a soldier auto' replaces 'break the shield'. Unverified: the exact duration of the Call of the Void silence and of the Nether Grasp suppression — neither kit file carries durations, so no number for either appears in the text.
